subject.title: fix(imessage): cap per-chat group-allowlist warn-once cache

question: Should maintainers require branch-level iMessage helper proof before merge, or explicitly override the proof gate for this cache-cap PR?
rationale: The code path is source-backed and the shared helper contract is clear, but contributor proof does not yet exercise the changed iMessage module after the patch.

options.title: Require branch-level helper proof

options.title: Accept proof override

options.title: Pause until checks refresh
